primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

wikipediaRead.locator: L1846–1854. The article says Uz names three characters and identifies the Dishan son as one of two sons, citing Genesis 36:28 and 1 Chronicles 1:42.
